In its comments on the completion report the ministry said the involuntary resettlement policy framework prepared for the project was unclear, and that completing the requirements in the remaining sub-projects "had a high cost for the nation".

appears_on.case_title: Wayuu Families Moved for Riohacha's Wastewater Lagoons and Left Without Electricity

appears_on.role: The Colombian department that was the project's implementing agency, through a project implementation unit, and which signed the commitments made to the Wayuu communities. The completion report records that between 2013 and 2017 the department had seven governors, four elected and three interim; that one governor blocked the project's advance for four years in office; and that the following governor was arrested within a year on charges of conspiracy in the murder of political rivals and removed from office. The project was later run under a Temporary Administration (Implementation Completion and Results Report, 15 October 2018).

appears_on.place: The Canal Lateral Neyba between the Cuatrifurcación and El Sifón, Neyba and Duvergé, Bahoruco and Independencia provinces; the La Gina irrigation system with the Arroyo Rico and Río Jayán dikes, Miches, El Seibo province; and the Yuna-Cañabón system, Bonao, Monseñor Nouel province, Dominican Republic
appears_on.role: The Dominican state's water resources institute, which built and rehabilitated the irrigation systems and carried out the expropriations. Its Departamento de Derecho de Vía, the right-of-way department, valued the plots and trees and signed the agreements with owners, working with the project's own execution unit. The corrective plan for the Canal Neyba describes the institute's standing practice: "se procede a las firmas de los permisos y los trabajos se inician sin haber pagado las compensaciones correspondientes" — permits are signed and the works begin without the compensation having been paid. The plan also says the execution unit lacked a thorough knowledge of the Bank's OP 4.12.

name: Gobierno Autónomo Descentralizado Municipal del Cantón Manta

appears_on.case_title: Properties Taken in Manta Before Any Agreement With Their Owners
appears_on.place: Vía Barbasquillo and the water and sanitation works of Manta, Manabí, Ecuador
appears_on.role: The municipality that borrowed and implemented, through a project implementation unit that had one social specialist and, the completion report says, low capacity. The report records that the unit's legal team, which prepared the resolutions and carried out the land acquisition, feared future problems with the Comptroller if it followed the Bank's resettlement policy instead of national law, so it "tended to delay decision making, did not implement agreements, and avoided compliance with OP 4.12". It had never run a project financed by a multilateral bank. The municipality had three different mayors and the unit four different leaders over the project's life, and the report records difficulties caused by political actors who wanted to manipulate the project's procurement (Implementation Completion and Results Report, 30 November 2021).
